gloss: to return; to be returned; to revert

definitions.gloss: to return; to be returned; to come back
definitions.explanation: Of something borrowed, lent, or taken — to come back to its owner or original place. Often used with きた to mean something has come back.

definitions.gloss: to revert; to return to a previous state
definitions.explanation: To go back to a former condition, such as consciousness returning, a situation reverting, or something going back to normal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{貸|か}した→貸す：00537_kasu⟧{本|ほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{返|かえ}ってきた。
examples.english: The book I lent finally came back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敷金|しききん}→敷金：06079_shikikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{返|かえ}ってきた。
examples.english: Part of the security deposit was returned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{返|かえ}ってくる⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no guarantee that the money invested will come back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{返|かえ}った。
⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{返|かえ}ってしまった。
examples.english: The conversation reverted to square one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧あと、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{返|かえ}る⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: After surgery, it took time for the body to return to its original state.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- {返|かえ}る (intransitive): something returns/comes back on its own
- ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧: to return something; to give back (transitive counterpart)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {返|かえ}ってくる: to come back (emphasizes movement toward the speaker)
- ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{返|かえ}る: to revert; to go back to how it was
- ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{返|かえ}る: consciousness returns

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to return home, to go back (used for people returning to a place)
- ⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to return; to come back — broader and more common in everyday speech
